_meta.purpose: Surface-level MODAL / DIALOG patterns. A modal is a screen-filling Backdrop with a single dialog surface (a Card, elevation 1) centered on top: a HEADER (title + optional description) + a BODY (a short message OR a few grouped fields) + a closing right-aligned ACTION row. Delivered via the runtime OVERLAY MODE (`overlay: true`). `level`: 'surface' = the whole dialog Card (incl. the surface wrapper); 'content' = a block nested inside the dialog's content column.
_meta.spacingModel: A modal inherits R from its product (content/website → R = lg, application/dashboard → R = md, dense data app → R = sm) and skews compact. Ladder (R-relative): Card padding = R AND the three regions (header/body/footer) to each other = R — they MATCH (inside a single card, padding and elements share the step R; the R+1 step is only for separate cards on a page); elements within a region = R; grouped bits (title↔description, field↔helper, choice options, footer button pair) = R−1. The patterns below are the R = md REFERENCE (Card spacing 'medium' = md padding; content column gap 'md' = the same step); substitute every gap per the product's R using the table in modal/blocks.json → _meta.spacingModel.
_meta.rendering: The overlay (Backdrop + centered Card) is added by the runtime OVERLAY MODE (`overlay: true`, `cardWidth`); the pattern's `plan` is just the dialog Card (elevation 1). Backdrop is a real registered component. The SIDE-SHEET Drawer variant is deferred (runtime does not fill the Drawer slot yet) — see modal/template.json → _meta.rendering. Backdrop open/close is out of scope (static frame only).
_meta.authoringRule: Components/tokens MUST resolve against components.json / tokens.json. New patterns are allowed when existing ones do not cover the need, provided they follow the spacingModel and resolve against the live registries.
_meta.placeholderConvention: <...> = fill with real content; optional trailing '?' means the node may be dropped when empty. A '<a|b|c>' placeholder is a closed choice.
_meta.refConvention: { "$ref": "block.id" } expands to that block's `plan` fragment from modal/blocks.json (or form/blocks.json for reused fields). The agent expands $ref when authoring the Composition Plan — the render runtime never sees $ref.

modal.dialog.purpose: The full dialog surface: a Card (elevationLevel '1', spacing 'medium') whose single content column (ContainerVertical, gap lg = R+1) holds the header, the body, and the right-aligned action row. Delivered via the runtime OVERLAY MODE (`overlay: true`, `cardWidth` ~400 confirmation/acknowledge, ~520 standard, ~640 form dialog) — the runtime adds the screen-filling Backdrop and centers this Card. Swap the body: modal.body-text for a confirm/acknowledge dialog, modal.body-fields for an input dialog. For an acknowledge dialog, drop the secondary button (single Brand action).

modal.header.purpose: The dialog header: title (Heading h2) + optional one-line description (Body, color.text.muted), grouped at sm. Always first. No close X — dialogs dismiss via the footer action row.

modal.body-text.purpose: The message body of a confirmation / acknowledge dialog: 1–2 short Body paragraphs, optionally led by a Notification (semantic Critical/Warning/Successful/Informational, closeable:false — no X inside the dialog). Keep it short.

modal.body-fields.purpose: The short input area of an input dialog: a few label-above, fillWidth fields reused verbatim from form/blocks.json (form.text-field / form.select-field / form.field-row / form.radio-group / form.checkbox-group). No form h1/h2 — the dialog title carries it. If it grows past a small fieldset → form/ screen.

modal.actions.purpose: The closing action row, RIGHT-ALIGNED (ContainerHorizontal, align 'right'): secondary (ghost/outlined) FIRST + primary (Brand, ≤1 per surface) RIGHTMOST. Always last. An acknowledge dialog drops the secondary.
